designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1987 to offset lowland habitat lost when the second powerhouse at Bonneville Dam was built.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Steigerwald Lake NWR was established in 1987 to offset lowland habitat loss caused by construction at the Bonneville dam.
